name: flow_results_link_lost_goes_offline
description: A party match ends (MATCH_END) and, on the results plate, the server's link goes. The party went with it: Play again leads to the hub offline, a party of one, and the hub says why, instead of a stale party (the old code, members 'in a match') whose Ready and Start reach no server. The match was over, so the word has no caretaker in it (review M5 round 2).

steps.assert: Session.state_name() == 'RESULTS' and node('ResultsPanel') != null and node('ResultsTitle').text == 'THE HOLDFAST HOLDS'
steps.msg: the results stay as they were
the client takes the closed link for lost, and the party with it

steps.assert: Session.state_name() == 'OFFLINE' and Session.client == null and Session.party_size() == 1
steps.msg: back in the hub, offline, a party of one

steps.assert: node('Place').text == 'Offline' and Session.last_notice == 'Your link was lost, and the party with it.'
steps.msg: and the hub says why the party is gone, with no caretaker in it: the match was over

steps.assert: node('Notice').visible and node('Notice').text == Session.last_notice and Session.hub_notice == ''

steps.msg: the panel is a party of one, not the old members
